import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long[] ONES = {0, 1, 11, 111, 1111, 11111, 111111, 1111111, 11111111, 111111111, 1111111111, 11111111111L, 111111111111L, 1111111111111L, 11111111111111L, 111111111111111L};

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(decompose(n));
    }

    static int digits(long n) {
        int d = 0;
        while (n > 0) {
            d++;
            n /= 10;
        }
        return d;
    }

    static long decompose(long n) {
        if (n <= 6) return n;
        int numDigits = digits(n);
        long lower = ONES[numDigits];
        long upper;
        if (n < lower) {
            upper = lower;
            lower = ONES[numDigits - 1];
        } else if (n > lower) {
            upper = ONES[numDigits + 1];
        } else {
            return numDigits;
        }
        long resLower = decompose(n % lower) + (n / lower) * digits(lower);
        long resUpper = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        if (upper - n < n) {
            resUpper = decompose(upper - n) + digits(upper);
        }
        return Math.min(resLower, resUpper);
    }
}

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public class Main {
    static final long[] ones = {0, 1, 11, 111, 1111, 11111, 111111, 1111111, 11111111, 111111111, 1111111111, 11111111111L, 111111111111L, 1111111111111L, 11111111111111L, 111111111111111L};

    static class FastScanner {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        private int index;
        private int size;

        FastScanner(InputStream in) {
            this.in = in;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (index >= size) {
                size = in.read(buffer);
                index = 0;
                if (size == -1) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[index++] & 0xff;
        }

        long nextLong() throws IOException {
            int b = read();
            while (b != -1 && b <= ' ') b = read();
            if (b == -1) throw new IOException("EOF");
            boolean neg = false;
            if (b == '-') {
                neg = true;
                b = read();
            } else if (b == '+') {
                b = read();
            }
            long num = 0;
            while (b != -1 && b > ' ') {
                num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
                b = read();
            }
            return neg ? -num : num;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner(System.in);
        long n = fs.nextLong();
        System.out.println(decompose(n));
    }

    static long getNumOfDigits(long n) {
        return (long) Math.floor(Math.log10(n)) + 1;
    }

    static long decompose(long n) {
        if (n <= 6) return n;
        long numOfDigits = getNumOfDigits(n);
        long lower = ones[(int) numOfDigits];
        long upper;
        if (n < lower) {
            upper = lower;
            lower = ones[(int) (numOfDigits - 1)];
        } else if (n > lower) {
            upper = ones[(int) (numOfDigits + 1)];
        } else {
            return numOfDigits;
        }
        long resLower = decompose(n % lower) + (n / lower) * getNumOfDigits(lower);
        long resUpper = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        if (upper - n < n) {
            resUpper = decompose(upper - n) + getNumOfDigits(upper);
        }
        return Math.min(resLower, resUpper);
    }
}

    static final Map<Long, Long> memo = new HashMap<>();

        long n = Long.parseLong(nextToken(br));
        System.out.println(decompose(n));

    private static String nextToken(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        StringBuilder token = new StringBuilder();
        int c;
        while ((c = br.read()) != -1 && Character.isWhitespace(c)) {}
        if (c == -1) throw new IOException("No token");
        token.append((char) c);
        while ((c = br.read()) != -1 && !Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
            token.append((char) c);
        }
        return token.toString();
    }

    static long getNumOfDigits(long n) {
        return Long.toString(n).length();
    }

    static long decompose(long n) {
        if (n <= 6) return n;
        Long cached = memo.get(n);

        int numDigits = (int) getNumOfDigits(n);
        long lower = ones[numDigits];
        long upper;
        if (n < lower) {
            upper = lower;
            lower = ones[numDigits - 1];

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long[] ones = {0, 1, 11, 111, 1111, 11111, 111111, 1111111, 11111111, 111111111, 1111111111, 11111111111L, 111111111111L, 1111111111111L, 11111111111111L, 111111111111111L};

    static class Frame {
        long n;
        int state;
        long lower;
        long upper;
        long gChild;
        long constG;
        long result;

        Frame(long n) {
            this.n = n;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(decompose(n));
    }

    static long getNumOfDigits(long n) {
        return (long) Math.floor(Math.log10(n)) + 1;
    }

    static long decompose(long n) {
        ArrayDeque<Frame> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        stack.push(new Frame(n));
        long lastResult = 0;

        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Frame f = stack.peek();

            if (f.state == -1) {
                stack.pop();
                lastResult = f.result;
                continue;
            }

            if (f.state == 0) {
                if (f.n <= 6) {
                    f.result = f.n;
                    f.state = -1;
                    continue;
                }
                int numDigits = (int) getNumOfDigits(f.n);
                long lower = ones[numDigits];
                long upper;
                if (f.n < lower) {
                    upper = lower;
                    lower = ones[numDigits - 1];
                } else if (f.n > lower) {
                    upper = ones[numDigits + 1];
                } else {
                    f.result = numDigits;
                    f.state = -1;
                    continue;
                }
                f.lower = lower;
                f.upper = upper;
                f.constG = (f.n / lower) * getNumOfDigits(lower);
                f.state = 1;
                stack.push(new Frame(f.n % lower));
            } else if (f.state == 1) {
                f.gChild = lastResult;
                if (f.upper - f.n < f.n) {
                    f.state = 2;
                    stack.push(new Frame(f.upper - f.n));
                } else {
                    f.result = f.gChild + f.constG;
                    f.state = -1;
                }
            } else if (f.state == 2) {
                long hChild = lastResult;
                f.result = Math.min(f.gChild + f.constG, hChild + getNumOfDigits(f.upper));
                f.state = -1;
            }
        }

        return lastResult;
    }
}
